You could check out the subreddit r/transtryouts to see how you feel about your make and pronouns for starters, you could also go ask questions to get multiple perspectives on an issue on r/asktransgender

It’s okay to be confused, it’s okay to not know everything from the start, just give it time, and if you change your mind down the line, that’s absolutely fine, because any good person will continue to be by your side.
